blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — The Davao City accountant presented as witness by Vice President Sara Duterte’s legal team cannot remember signing documents and other details related to an accounting firm — which also was responsible for auditing companies linked to her. During Duterte’s impeachment trial on Tuesday, several senator-judges including Senate Impeachment Court Presiding Officer Francis Escudero were visibly frustrated with City Accountant Vingelin Bajan’s failure to remember signing documents that made her a partner of the Ampil, Elises, Ciudadano & Co. CPAs — an accounting firm of certified public accountants. Bajan was confronted by counsel for the prosecution Mae Divinagracia with the […]...
